messages:
Zoe (Recruiter): Liam accepted the L3 offer last night. He just messaged saying his family's move got accelerated and he can start 2026-04-18 instead of 2026-05-02. He asked if any of the $8k sign-on can be advanced.
Arjun (Hiring Manager): I can onboard him earlier. He needs cash for movers though. Any ability to advance part of the sign-on?
Hannah (People Ops): Standard payout is 100% at 90 days. Frontload requires comp exception + amendment + payroll PR. Alternative is a one-off relocation stipend processed via expense. Which does the manager prefer?
Arjun (Hiring Manager): Prefers frontload 40% to land with first payroll. Manager note: strong candidate, risk of losing if we can't help.
Zoe (Recruiter): Candidate says frontload is ideal and can sign an amendment today.
PeopleOps-Bot: New request created REQ-2026-3024 "Frontload 40% sign-on for early start". Routing: Comp -> Legal -> Payroll. Typical SLA 3 business days.
Ken (Comp): Need confirmation base is unchanged and manager retention rationale. If docs are complete I can fast-track to chair.
Legal (Sanjay): No legal red flags. Amendment should include payment schedule and 90-day clawback. I can prepare a short form.
Payroll Bot: To include partial sign-on on run 2026-04-18 we need PR and signed amendment by 2026-04-10 11:00 PT. Otherwise next run 05/02.
Hannah (People Ops): I'll ping comp chair for expedited review. Zoe, please attach manager justification and candidate acknowledgement.
Zoe (Recruiter): Manager note attached: "retention risk - multiple offers". Candidate acknowledgement attached and says will sign amendment.
Ken (Comp): Approved 40% frontload under "early relocation assistance". Chair sign-off obtained.
Legal (Sanjay): Amendment posted AMEND-721 with clawback. Zoe please get signed.
Payroll Bot: PR#721-FL received. Scheduling $3,200 on 2026-04-18 and remaining $4,800 on 2026-07-01.
Hannah (People Ops): All set; updated start date to 2026-04-18 in HRIS and noted exception.
Zoe (Recruiter): Amendment signed by Liam (attached). Confirmed start 2026-04-18. Thanks all :tada:
